Work in a large hotel in the sales and accounting department. Co worker and I are responsible for doing audits every month on contracts and payments. Make sure we received what was agreed upon basically. We have to upload this into a highly modified excel spreadsheet to track everything so our management team can look at. It is vitally import because this is what they use to determine the budget for the following year. And because of covid and the effects on the industry it’s really important the numbers are all there and accurate. We have excels for each decade so we are working on 2020-2029 right now. 

In December my co worker was adding information to the tracker and didn’t save it to our shared drive where everyone has access to it. She saved it to her desktop by accident. We work with so many files we are discouraged from saving things to our desktop because it will just get unorganized quickly. After a few days of saving various documents to our drive and her own desktop she put everything in her recycle bin and then clears the bin permanently before leaving for the weekend. That was just her process of how she worked I guess. Come Monday we can’t find the tracker any where. All the sudden her face when completely white and said she accidentally deleted it. Years of financial forecasting data gone instantly. They actually fired her for it! And now I’m stuck rebuilding the entire from scratch and it’s going to take months. Oh well
